name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a specialized contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a specialized contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor, like Cali View Builders, manages the entire renovation project, overseeing all aspects from planning to completion. This includes coordinating various trades, managing schedules, and ensuring the project stays within budget and meets quality standards. A specialized contractor, on the other hand, focuses on a single trade, such as plumbing, electrical, or roofing. While they are experts in their specific field, they typically don't manage the overall project. For comprehensive renovations, a general contractor simplifies the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages the entire project, while a specialized contractor focuses on a single trade. For comprehensive renovations, a general contractor is usually preferred.
